description:
Create a selective backup of NinjaTrader 8 configurations.

Your task is to use the Backup tool to create a lightweight archive of just your layout and chart settings:

1. Open Tools > Export > Backup...
2. In the backup dialog, select ONLY 'Templates' and 'Workspaces'.
3. Ensure all other options (especially 'Database', 'Historical Data', 'Log Files') are UNCHECKED to keep the file small.
4. Save the backup as 'config_backup.zip' to the folder 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\NinjaTraderTasks\'.
